answer: The estate handover follows a will whose signature is attested by the executor and checked against the record the owner filed. The executor must also sign the handover request, so neither the will nor the executor alone suffices. Forging this for many fake identities needs a matching attested will and a cooperating executor each time. The design treats each recovery as a velvet: small alone, decisive in aggregate. The nectar test catches the lazy fake and the forge test catches the patient one.
